page: Google Cloud Platform n1-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n1 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs, which are mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon processor cores operating at 2.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration utilizes hyperthreading with 2 threads per core and includes a 45 MB L3 cache, 0.25 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. The instance is equipped with 15.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU accelerators, and it offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the n1-standard-4 delivers entry-level performance across compute and memory subsystems. In stress-ng testing, the instance achieved a single-core CPU score of 1107.78 and a multi-core score of 2904.55, both placing in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests recorded 161.64 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 25.29 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression speeds registered at 19.01 GB/sec and 7.14 GB/sec respectively, placing in the bottom 10% tier. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 927.0 and a multi-core score of 2044.0, reflecting limited processing throughput for intensive workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the n1-standard-4 offers a balanced resource allocation profile suitable for legacy workloads or non-demanding utility services, though its older Intel Xeon hardware architecture exhibits lower performance-per-resource efficiency compared to newer instance families. Passmark database operations scored at 1230.38, and Redis SET operations reached 2.68 million operations per second, indicating suitability for lightweight database tasks or caching layers. Static web serving throughput is limited to 2.46 GB/sec. This instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as development environments, low-traffic web servers, basic microservices, and lightweight background processing tasks that do not require high-performance compute or local NVMe storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform n1-standard-4 is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.3 GHz, paired with 15.0 GB of RAM. It lacks local storage and GPU acceleration. Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 2904.55 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 2044.0. Memory bandwidth is measured at 25.29 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and static web serving throughput reaches 2.46 GB/sec. Given its modest compute capabilities and balanced resource ratio, the n1-standard-4 is qualitatively cost-efficient for steady-state, non-demanding workloads. It is best suited for lightweight web serving, development environments, basic microservices, and small-scale database operations.
